# Repository instructions for Copilot

Follow `AGENTS.md` and use `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md` as the authoritative short
project memory.

For each task, read only the assigned issue and the files named in its **Inputs**
section. Do not automatically scan all routes, open pull requests, historical
commits, certificate files, or generated artifacts.

Work on one exact mathematical claim. Identify its earliest unsupported step and
attempt to falsify that step before extending the argument. Do not create new
routes or large computations unless explicitly authorized.

End with the concise issue handoff specified in `AGENTS.md`.
